tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Brand colour 'Renewables' (manual p.8: CMYK 59/0/88/0, RGB 120/185/72). Stands for renewables, sustainability, growth, innovation. Use for large fills, section rules and the 'INNO' half of the logotype. Not for text on surface (2.4:1, fails); text on a green fill uses on-green. The manual's own white labels on green also fail (2.4:1).

tokens.name: light-blue
tokens.usage: Brand colour 'Digital platforms' (manual calls it Light Blue; CMYK 84/45/4/0, RGB 25/120/184). Stands for clean energy, trust, connection, data. Use for fills, links and accent text on surface (4.75:1). On surface-muted it reaches 4.2:1, so use it there only at 24px+ or bold 19px+. Text on a light-blue fill uses on-light-blue.

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: Brand colour 'Community' (CMYK 0/60/93/0, RGB 239/125/28). Stands for warmth, energy flow, inclusion, activity. Use for fills and highlights, not for text on surface (2.8:1, fails). Text on an orange fill uses on-orange. The manual's own white labels on orange also fail (2.8:1).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body text on surface, surface-muted, green-tint, light-blue-tint and stone (all 8.6:1 or more). Sampled from the manual's heading colour; not a specified code.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background; the manual's page ground.

tokens.name: surface-muted
tokens.usage: Header bands and quiet panels, as in the manual's running page header. Sampled from the manual layout.

tokens.name: green-tint
tokens.usage: Pale green ground; one of the manual's approved logo backgrounds (p.7) for the full-colour logo. Sampled from the manual layout.

tokens.name: light-blue-tint
tokens.usage: Pale blue ground; one of the manual's approved logo backgrounds (p.7) for the full-colour logo. Sampled from the manual layout.

tokens.name: stone
tokens.usage: Warm light grey; approved logo background (p.7) for the one-colour black logo. Sampled from the manual layout.

tokens.name: stone-light
tokens.usage: Lighter warm grey; approved logo background (p.7) for the one-colour black logo. Sampled from the manual layout.

tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: Approved logo background (p.7) for the one-colour white logo.

tokens.name: logo-grey
tokens.usage: Darker ink of the greyscale logo files (replaces light-blue there). Describes the asset only; not for text.

tokens.name: logo-grey-light
tokens.usage: Lighter ink of the greyscale logo files (replaces green there). Describes the asset only; not for text.

tokens.name: on-green
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a green fill (4.6:1). Proposed; the manual uses white, which fails.

tokens.name: on-light-blue
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a light-blue fill (4.75:1).

tokens.name: on-orange
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an orange fill (7.6:1). Proposed; the manual uses white, which fails, and ink reaches only 4.0:1.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, hints and metadata on surface, surface-muted, stone and the tints (5.3:1 or more). Proposed.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Dividers, table rules and card borders. Decorative only; not for control borders. Proposed.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects and secondary buttons (3.4:1 on surface, 3.1:1 on surface-muted). Proposed.

tokens.name: orange-tint
tokens.usage: Pale orange ground behind ink text, e.g. the warning alert and estimated-data badge. Proposed.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, failed actions, destructive buttons. As text on surface (6.6:1) or danger-tint (5.4:1); white text on a danger fill (6.6:1). Always paired with a word, never colour alone. Proposed; the manual has no red.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Pale red ground behind danger text, e.g. the failed badge. Proposed.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid outline, offset 2px; 4.75:1 on surface, 4.2:1 on surface-muted. Proposed.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Section titles, set in capitals like the manual. Figtree Bold is the manual's primary font; size proposed from its 40pt section titles.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Page and card titles. Size proposed.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Sub-headings and section labels under a green rule. Size proposed.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The logo is the key element of the project identity.
styles.usage: Running text. Open Sans is the manual's secondary font. Size proposed.

styles.name: body-light
styles.usage: Lead paragraphs and long descriptive text; the manual sets most body copy in Open Sans Light. Size proposed.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Labels, table headers, buttons. Size proposed.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Captions, footers, page folios. Size proposed.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Wallet IDs, transaction IDs and hashes in manager and support screens. Proposed; the manual names no monospace face.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps: icon to label. Proposed.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside components. Proposed.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and panel padding. Proposed.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gaps between sections and page margins. Proposed.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Default for blocks, panels and buttons: the manual uses square corners throughout.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs and small controls where a hard corner reads harsh. Proposed.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Discs and pills, echoing the circles in the logo symbol. Proposed.
